title: First rehearsals in London
note: Jimmy Page, Robert Plant, John Paul Jones and John Bonham play together for the first time.

title: First show, in Denmark
note: Billed as the New Yardbirds, at the Gladsaxe Teen Clubs near Copenhagen, at the start of a short Scandinavian tour.

title: The name Led Zeppelin
note: Autumn 1968 shows in Britain are the first under the new name.

title: First American show
note: Denver, Colorado, on the first of many North American tours.

title: Royal Albert Hall
note: A London show filmed at the time and released decades later on the 2003 DVD.

title: Stairway to Heaven played live for the first time
note: At the Ulster Hall, Belfast, months before the fourth album came out.

title: Tampa Stadium
note: Reported at the time as the largest audience for a single act at one American concert.

title: Madison Square Garden filmed
note: Three July nights in New York become The Song Remains the Same.

title: Swan Song Records
note: The band launch their own label; Physical Graffiti is its first Led Zeppelin release.

title: Five nights at Earls Court
note: A run of London shows in May 1975.

title: Plant injured in a car crash
note: The accident on Rhodes stops the band touring until 1977.

title: 1977 American tour cut short
note: The tour is cancelled after the death of Robert Plant's son Karac.

title: Knebworth
note: Two outdoor shows in August 1979, the band's first in Britain for four years, after warm-up shows in Copenhagen.

title: Last show with John Bonham
note: Berlin, the final night of the Tour Over Europe.

title: John Bonham dies
note: He was 32.

title: The band end
note: A short statement says they cannot continue as they were.

title: Live Aid
note: Page, Plant and Jones reunite in Philadelphia with Phil Collins and Tony Thompson on drums.

title: Atlantic Records 40th anniversary
note: A reunion at Madison Square Garden with Jason Bonham on drums.

title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
note: The band are inducted.

title: The O2 Arena, London
note: A full reunion show in tribute to Atlantic Records founder Ahmet Ertegun, with Jason Bonham on drums.

title: Kennedy Center Honors
note: Page, Plant and Jones are honoured in Washington.

title: Remastered editions begin
note: Jimmy Page oversees remasters with companion discs of unreleased material, issued through 2015.

title: Becoming Led Zeppelin
note: The band's first authorised documentary reaches cinemas.
